part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Your friends
questions: Do you prefer to have one particular friend or a group of friends? [Why?]
What do you like doing most with your friend/s?
Do you think it's important to keep in contact with friends you knew as a child? [Why/Why not?]
What makes a friend into a good friend?

part2.topic: Describe an important choice you had to make in your life.
points: when you had to make this choice
what you had to choose between
whether you made a good choice
part2.closing: and explain how you felt when you were making this choice.

topics.title: Important choices
questions: What are the typical choices people make at different stages of their lives?
Should important choices be made by parents rather than by young adults?
Why do some people like to discuss choices with other people?

topics.title: Choices in everyday life
questions: What kind of choices do people have to make in their everyday life?
Why do some people choose to do the same things every day? Are there any disadvantages in this?
Do you think that people today have more choices to make today than in the past?
